title: •Atmospheric Assault
caption: •Atmospheric Assault (V)
game_text: If your TIE is defending a battle alone at a cloud sector, add two destiny to power only. OR During battle, if you have a TIE present piloted by a character, opponent’s starship present without a pilot character aboard is power -3.
lore: The TIEs patrolling Cloud City took advantage of Bespin’s dense cloud cover.

notes: Unique. Printed base is a Lost Interrupt; slip banner reads USED INTERRUPT. 'OR During' with capital D as printed. Curly apostrophe in opponent’s. No inline icons; slip text matches the stub. The wiki's default 'Atmospheric Assault' page carries Glossary 2.0 errata text; printed face = 'Atmospheric Assault (Original)' (same lore/destiny/set). The 745 px CC-D-atmosphericassault.gif is tagged D-E1 (errata face) — downloaded to src/vs6/28-CC-D-atmosphericassault.gif for art only; the 350 px decipher-archive scan is the printed face used as src. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Bespin’s (wiki straight). Copyright 1997 legible on the 745 px face. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
